title: feat(console): the object list keeps the page a reader turned to, in the address
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XMsoTAj6Y44LLZQepuTgtsc)_

Fixes #30850

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:控制台对象列表把当前页码写进地址栏(`uf__page`,用 replace 写,不新增历史记录)。翻到第 2 页、整页打开一条记录、再按返回,列表回到第 2 页;刷新和复制链接也落在同一页。手机上卡片列表的翻页同样生效。`ListView` 新增两个宿主属性 `page` / `onPageChange`(受控页码,和 `sort` 由宿主持有同一思路),不传时行为不变。
- 为什么改:维护者裁决 6708434746 选了方案 A(页码进 URL)。记录路由与列表路由是兄弟路由,整页打开记录会卸载列表,原来的页码是组件内 `useState(1)`,返回后总是第 1 页。手机上每条记录都整页打开,所以手机用户每看一条就回到第 1 页。
- 风险与回滚:两条既有规则保留:对象、筛选、排序、搜索、分组、每页条数或视图一变就回第 1 页并清掉参数;页码超出末页时收到最后一页。实现中发现一个连带问题并一起修了:路由器的函数式 `setSearchParams` 基于上一次渲染的参数,在第 2 页输入搜索词时,搜索写入和随之触发的「回第 1 页」写入会互相覆盖,搜索词丢失。现在 `ObjectView` 的写入在地址变化前串联。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx`(写入串联,风险最高的一段),`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`(受控页码与 `setServerPage`),`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/userFilterUrlState.ts`(`uf__page` 的读写)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.listPageInUrl-30850.test.tsx`,预期 `Tests 6 passed (6)`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@object-ui/plugin-list` — a controlled page.** `ListView` declares two host props, `page` and `onPageChange`. Passing `page` makes the page controlled: the list reads it every render and asks for every move through `onPageChange` (the pager; the existing reset to page 1 when the object, filters, sort, search, grouping, page size or view change; the existing clamp to the last reachable page when a load comes back empty past the end). `setServerPage` stays the one door every move goes through; it is now stable and reads the latest committed page and host callback through a ref set in a layout effect, because the fetch effect's clamp and the sort handlers call it from closures taken renders ago. A move to the page already shown calls nothing. Without `page` the list keeps its page itself, exactly as before, and `onPageChange` only reports the move. Both props are destructured by name, so neither rides the `{...props}` forward into the view component.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell` — the binding.** The list's page joins the `uf_` list-state family as `uf__page` (`LIST_PAGE_PARAM`), owned by `userFilterUrlState.ts`. `parseListPageParam` reads it strictly: a whole number from 1 up, else page 1. `applyListStateParams({ page })` writes a page past 1 and deletes the param for page 1 or `null`. `useObjectViewListUrlState` reads it from the address every render (`listPage`), and `objectViewListRenderer` passes it to `ListView` as `page`, with `onPageChange` writing back through `writeListUrlState({ page })`, which replaces the entry.
- **Name choice against `urlParams.ts`.** `RESERVED_URL_PARAMS` does not hold `uf__page` (pinned). The bare name `page` was not taken: the `AppContent` docblock above `RECORD_NAMED_PAGE_ROUTE` records `page` as a page-scoped list parameter "elsewhere", and the `uf_` family is where the object list already keeps its search, sort, filter and grouping, so the sign-out return link (`withoutListStateParams`) and "Reset to view" drop it with the rest without new code paths.
- **The page is the reader's place, not list state.** `uf__page` is left out of `userFilterParamsKey`, so a page alone never makes an address read as a link that carries list state (which would skip the reader's stored sort and filters), and out of `parseUserFilterParams`, so it is never read as a quick-filter chip on a field named `_page`. It is not part of the seed: it is read live on every render.
- **Write chaining in `ObjectView`.** React Router's functional `setSearchParams` starts from the params it last rendered, and the navigation commits in a transition. A search typed on page 2 wrote `uf__search`, then the list's reset wrote "delete `uf__page`" from the same stale params, and the search term was lost (the real-router test below caught it). `ObjectView`'s one setter now starts each write from the previous write until `location.key` moves. It serves every writer on the page (list state, quick-filter chips, the drawer's `recordId`), so a chip change on page 2 is covered by the same fix.
- **README** (`ui/packages/plugin-list/README.md`): a "Host props: `page` and `onPageChange`" section beside the other host props.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/30850-list-page-in-url.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-list` and `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, `Clause-②: yes (widening)` (plugin-list's published `ListViewProps` gains two optional props; app-shell's module exports gain `LIST_PAGE_PARAM` and `parseListPageParam`), `Metadata-protocol: none`. No i18n key is added, changed or removed.

## Why

Ruling 6708434746 (maintainer 「同意」 to A): the list page goes in the URL as a page-scoped param named against `urlParams.ts`, written with `replace`, cleared by the reset-to-1 rule. The record route is a sibling of the list route in `AppContent`, so a record opened as a full page unmounts `ObjectView` and `ListView`, and the list's `useState(1)` page started over on Back. On a phone every record opens as a page (#27058), so every phone reader lost their place after each record.

**Phone measurement first (the ruling's precondition).** The phone list pages; it does not load on scroll. `ObjectGrid`'s card face (below the app breakpoint) ends in `object-grid-card-pager`, which calls the same `manualOnPageChange` the table's pager does, and there is no scroll or intersection loader in the card path. Measured in a rendered test at 390 px through the real `ObjectView` and grid: the card pager is drawn, its Next turns to page 2 (`$skip` 10), and Back from the record page lands on page 2 with `Page 2 of 3`. So no batch or scroll restore is owed. Not measured on a physical device or a live Console at phone width.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.listPageInUrl-30850.test.tsx` (6 cases). This page, `plugin-view`'s `ObjectView`, `plugin-list`'s `ListView` and `plugin-grid`'s grid and card list render for real under a `MemoryRouter` whose record route is the list route's sibling, as in `AppContent`. Every step is a click (`fireEvent`) and the window the list asked for is read at the data source:
  - desktop: Next page → `uf__page=2`, `$skip` 10, every navigation `REPLACE`; the row's ↗ "Open as full page" → the record route, list unmounted; Back → `uf__page=2`, the remounted list asks only for `$skip` 10, the pager reads `Page 2 of 3`; one more Back leaves the list;
  - phone (390 px): the card pager turns to page 2; a card tap opens the record page; Back → page 2, `Page 2 of 3` on the card pager;
  - a reload or copied link with `uf__page=3` asks only for `$skip` 20;
  - a search typed on page 2 → `uf__search` written, `uf__page` gone, the window `{ skip: 0, search }`;
  - `uf__page=40` clamps to page 3 and the address follows;
  - control: `uf__page=two` opens page 1.
- New `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.controlledPage-30850.test.tsx` (7 cases, stub grid as in `ListView.serverPagination.test.tsx`): opens on the host's page with no page-1 window first; a pager move goes to the host and the window follows the value passed back; control: a host that does not pass the move back keeps the list where it is, no refetch; a query change sends the host back to 1; past the end clamps through the host; a move to the page already shown calls nothing; control: uncontrolled keeps its own page and still reports the move.
- New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/userFilterUrlState.listPage-30850.test.ts` (7 cases): the spelling and no collision with `RESERVED_URL_PARAMS`; strict reading (`0`, `-2`, `2.5`, `1e3`, ` 2`, `02`, `two`, a 30-digit value all read as 1); page 1 and `null` delete, a patch without `page` leaves it; not a chip; not in `userFilterParamsKey`; dropped by both `withoutListStateParams`.
- **Ablations**, see Verification.

## Acceptance notes

- **Page size is not in the address.** A page size the reader picks in the pager is still `ListView` component state (no host stores it, before or after this change). Picking one resets to page 1 and clears the param, but after a full-page open and Back the list returns to the declared or default size while `uf__page` keeps its number, so the page number then counts windows of that size. Within the ruling's scope (the page only); noted, not filed.
- **A malformed `uf__page` stays in the address** until the next move writes the param; it opens page 1 and changes nothing else. The other `uf_` params are rewritten on load by the seed; the page has no seed by design.
- **Write chaining reaches every writer of `ObjectView`'s search params**, not only the list's. It changes nothing when writes are already a render apart (the base is then the rendered params, as before); it only stops a second write in the same window from undoing the first.
- **Live Console not run.** The round trip and the phone path are proved by rendered tests through the real router and the real list and grid, not by a browser against a backend.

## Verification

Base `8ef4d309` (`origin/main` when the branch was cut). Heavy runs through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.

<details><summary>Suites and type-checks</summary>

- Prerequisite: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' --filter '@object-ui/plugin-list^...' build`, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=3 --reporter=dot packages/plugin-list/` plus the 171 app-shell test files that import `ObjectView`, `userFilterUrlState`, `objectViewListUrlState`, `objectViewListRenderer` or `plugin-list` (on `ed830606`; head `5793838e` differs only by one test-file import): Test Files 343 passed (343), Tests 3749 passed (3749), VERDICT command-exit 0. The whole app-shell suite (2,212 files) is left to CI's Test UI.
- The three new files on head `5793838e`: Test Files 3 passed (3), Tests 20 passed (20), VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-list run type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (each `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec eslint` over the eight touched or new source and test files: exit 0, 0 errors.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (3, each red, each restored)</summary>

Each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor hit once, mutation proven on disk by anchor count and blob change, restore proven by blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. ui vitest aliases `@object-ui/plugin-list` to `src`, so no build sits on the path.

| # | Mutation | Red |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | `ListView` ignores `page` (`const serverPage = ownPage;`) | 10 failed / 3 passed across the plugin-list and ObjectView files (the 3 are the uncontrolled control, the same-page no-call case and the malformed-value control) |
| A2 | `ObjectView` writes stop chaining (`pending && false`) | 1 failed / 5 passed (the search on page 2 loses its term) |
| A3 | `uf__page` counted in `userFilterParamsKey` | 1 failed / 6 passed (the page alone keys as nothing) |

A3's first attempt was refused by the tool before running (its replacement text already occurred in the file, so the count could not rise); it was rerun with a distinct replacement, and the reading above is the rerun.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates (dispatch-gates --commands, 36 families, plus 4)</summary>

All on head `5793838e`, exit codes captured before any pipe.

- 36 derived, 36 run, all exit 0. `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: "36 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 36 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".
- Among them `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: Test Files 170 passed | 2 skipped (172), Tests 4996 passed | 2 skipped (4998).
- Run beyond the derivation, all exit 0: both type-checks, the eslint run above, and `pnpm --dir ui check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations).
- The first round (head `ed830606`) had one red: `check:test-source-alias` asked the new ObjectView test to load `@objectstack/lint` at module top, since `ObjectView` reaches a dynamic `import('@objectstack/lint')` through `celAuthoring.ts`. `5793838e` adds that import; every family was then rerun.
